title: Lowering the Feistel Crooked-Indifferentiability Round Constant
summary: The Feistel construction is proved crooked-indifferentiable with round-bound constant 337; whether refined proof parameters can lower it below 200 remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the Feistel construction considered under crooked indifferentiability, the proven sufficient number of rounds is $\ell \geq 337n/\log(1/\epsilon)$. Can the proof parameters be refined to establish crooked indifferentiability with $\ell \geq cn/\log(1/\epsilon)$ for some constant $c<200$?

scope.domain: Round complexity of Feistel constructions under crooked indifferentiability.
parameters: n: size parameter in the round bound
ε: parameter governing the logarithmic term in the round bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Refine the proof parameters to establish crooked indifferentiability with the stated round bound for some constant c below 200.

citations.label: Crooked Indifferentiability of the Feistel Construction

progress.summary: After proving the round bound with constant 337, the paper remarks that a more careful choice of proof parameters could potentially reduce the constant below 200.
citation_labels: Alexander Russell et al., Crooked Indifferentiability of the Feistel Construction
